WITH t AS (
SELECT tr.*, CAST(Price AS DECIMAL(38,6)) AS p,
CASE WHEN Date IS NOT NULL AND Time REGEXP '^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]:[0-5][0-9]$'
THEN TIMESTAMP(Date,Time) ELSE NULL END AS ts FROM birdbench.transactions_1k tr),
m AS (SELECT CustomerID, Date AS ym, STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(Date,'01'),'%%Y%%m%%d') AS md,
CAST(Consumption AS DECIMAL(38,6)) AS v FROM birdbench.yearmonth
WHERE Date REGEXP '^[0-9]{4}(0[1-9]|1[0-2])$' AND LEFT(Date,4) BETWEEN '1000' AND '9999')
, edges AS (SELECT DISTINCT CustomerID,ProductID FROM t WHERE CustomerID IS NOT NULL AND ProductID IS NOT NULL),
sizes AS (SELECT ProductID,COUNT(*) n FROM edges GROUP BY ProductID),
pairs AS (SELECT a.ProductID pa,b.ProductID pb,COUNT(*) n FROM edges a JOIN edges b ON a.CustomerID=b.CustomerID AND a.ProductID<b.ProductID GROUP BY a.ProductID,b.ProductID)
SELECT pa product_a,pb product_b,x.n shared_customers,a.n+b.n-x.n union_customers,ROUND(CAST(x.n AS DECIMAL(60,18))/(a.n+b.n-x.n),6) jaccard FROM pairs x JOIN sizes a ON pa=a.ProductID JOIN sizes b ON pb=b.ProductID ORDER BY pa,pb

WITH t AS (
SELECT tr.*, CAST(Price AS DECIMAL(38,6)) AS p,
CASE WHEN Date IS NOT NULL AND Time REGEXP '^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]:[0-5][0-9]$'
THEN TIMESTAMP(Date,Time) ELSE NULL END AS ts FROM birdbench.transactions_1k tr),
m AS (SELECT CustomerID, Date AS ym, STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(Date,'01'),'%%Y%%m%%d') AS md,
CAST(Consumption AS DECIMAL(38,6)) AS v FROM birdbench.yearmonth
WHERE Date REGEXP '^[0-9]{4}(0[1-9]|1[0-2])$' AND LEFT(Date,4) BETWEEN '1000' AND '9999')
, a AS (SELECT c.Currency,t.TransactionID,t.p,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY c.Currency ORDER BY t.p,t.TransactionID) rn,COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY c.Currency) n FROM t JOIN birdbench.customers c ON t.CustomerID=c.CustomerID WHERE c.Currency IS NOT NULL AND t.p IS NOT NULL),
med AS (SELECT Currency,MAX(n) n,AVG(p) med FROM a WHERE rn IN (FLOOR((n+1)/2),FLOOR((n+2)/2)) GROUP BY Currency),
dev AS (SELECT a.Currency,a.TransactionID,ABS(a.p-med.med) d,med.med,med.n FROM a JOIN med ON a.Currency=med.Currency),
ranked AS (SELECT dev.*,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY Currency ORDER BY d,TransactionID) rn FROM dev)
SELECT Currency currency,MAX(n) observation_count,ROUND(MAX(med),6) median_price,ROUND(AVG(d),6) mad_price FROM ranked WHERE rn IN (FLOOR((n+1)/2),FLOOR((n+2)/2)) GROUP BY Currency ORDER BY Currency

WITH t AS (
SELECT tr.*, CAST(Price AS DECIMAL(38,6)) AS p,
CASE WHEN Date IS NOT NULL AND Time REGEXP '^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]:[0-5][0-9]$'
THEN TIMESTAMP(Date,Time) ELSE NULL END AS ts FROM birdbench.transactions_1k tr),
m AS (SELECT CustomerID, Date AS ym, STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(Date,'01'),'%%Y%%m%%d') AS md,
CAST(Consumption AS DECIMAL(38,6)) AS v FROM birdbench.yearmonth
WHERE Date REGEXP '^[0-9]{4}(0[1-9]|1[0-2])$' AND LEFT(Date,4) BETWEEN '1000' AND '9999')
, a AS (SELECT c.Currency,t.ProductID,SUM(t.Amount) v FROM t JOIN birdbench.customers c ON t.CustomerID=c.CustomerID WHERE c.Currency IS NOT NULL AND t.ProductID IS NOT NULL AND t.Amount>0 GROUP BY c.Currency,t.ProductID),b AS (SELECT a.*,SUM(v) OVER(PARTITION BY Currency) total FROM a)
SELECT Currency currency,COUNT(*) product_count,ROUND(SUM(POWER(CAST(v AS DECIMAL(60,18))/total,2)),6) hhi FROM b GROUP BY Currency ORDER BY Currency

WITH t AS (
SELECT tr.*, CAST(Price AS DECIMAL(38,6)) AS p,
CASE WHEN Date IS NOT NULL AND Time REGEXP '^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]:[0-5][0-9]$'
THEN TIMESTAMP(Date,Time) ELSE NULL END AS ts FROM birdbench.transactions_1k tr),
m AS (SELECT CustomerID, Date AS ym, STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(Date,'01'),'%%Y%%m%%d') AS md,
CAST(Consumption AS DECIMAL(38,6)) AS v FROM birdbench.yearmonth
WHERE Date REGEXP '^[0-9]{4}(0[1-9]|1[0-2])$' AND LEFT(Date,4) BETWEEN '1000' AND '9999')
, a AS (SELECT c.Currency,c.Segment,COUNT(*) n,SUM(t.p) total,AVG(t.p) mean_p FROM t JOIN birdbench.customers c ON t.CustomerID=c.CustomerID WHERE c.Currency IS NOT NULL AND c.Segment IS NOT NULL AND t.p IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.Currency,c.Segment),u AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Currency) n FROM a),common AS (SELECT Segment FROM a GROUP BY Segment HAVING COUNT(*)=(SELECT n FROM u))
SELECT a.Currency currency,COUNT(*) common_segments,ROUND(AVG(a.mean_p),6) standardized_mean,ROUND(CAST(SUM(a.total) AS DECIMAL(60,18))/SUM(a.n),6) raw_matched_mean FROM a JOIN common b ON a.Segment=b.Segment GROUP BY a.Currency ORDER BY a.Currency

WITH t AS (
SELECT tr.*, CAST(Price AS DECIMAL(38,6)) AS p,
CASE WHEN Date IS NOT NULL AND Time REGEXP '^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]:[0-5][0-9]$'
THEN TIMESTAMP(Date,Time) ELSE NULL END AS ts FROM birdbench.transactions_1k tr),
m AS (SELECT CustomerID, Date AS ym, STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(Date,'01'),'%%Y%%m%%d') AS md,
CAST(Consumption AS DECIMAL(38,6)) AS v FROM birdbench.yearmonth
WHERE Date REGEXP '^[0-9]{4}(0[1-9]|1[0-2])$' AND LEFT(Date,4) BETWEEN '1000' AND '9999'), a AS (SELECT c.Currency,t.ProductID,t.CustomerID,COUNT(*) n,SUM(t.p) total FROM t JOIN birdbench.customers c ON t.CustomerID=c.CustomerID WHERE c.Currency IS NOT NULL AND t.ProductID IS NOT NULL AND t.p IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.Currency,t.ProductID,t.CustomerID),
b AS (SELECT a.*,SUM(n) OVER(PARTITION BY Currency,ProductID) all_n,SUM(total) OVER(PARTITION BY Currency,ProductID) all_total FROM a),
g AS (SELECT Currency,CAST(total AS DECIMAL(60,18))/n-CAST(all_total-total AS DECIMAL(60,18))/(all_n-n) gap FROM b WHERE all_n>n)
SELECT Currency currency,COUNT(*) eligible_customer_product_pairs,SUM(CASE WHEN gap>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) above_peer_pairs,ROUND(AVG(gap),6) mean_price_gap FROM g GROUP BY Currency ORDER BY Currency
